summary: Completed frontend testing of Janmashtami-themed Footer redesign. All 15 features passed on both desktop (1920px) and mobile (390px) viewports. Footer renders correctly with all decorative elements, links, and responsive layout.
passed_tests: Footer section renders with data-testid='footer-section' and is visible on homepage
Footer top banner strip (data-testid='footer-banner-strip') shows 'Janmashtami Special' text in gold/yellow on maroon background
Floral garland toran image is visible at top of footer
Hanging bell images are rendered (2 bell img elements with alt='Temple bell')
Peacock feather images are rendered (2 img elements with alt='Peacock feather')
Devotional Hindi text '॥ राधे राधे ॥' is displayed in the footer
Flute emoji divider (🪈) is present below the Radhe Radhe text
Footer contains Quick Links section with Home, Categories, New Arrivals, Track Order, Terms & Conditions links
Footer contains Contact Us section with phone number, email, Instagram, and location
WhatsApp order button (data-testid='footer-whatsapp-btn') is green (#25D366) and links to wa.me
Copyright text shows current year (2026) and 'Kridhani Jewels'
Footer is responsive on mobile viewport (390px width) - no horizontal overflow
No JavaScript console errors on the page
critical_code_review_comments: Footer.jsx uses proper data-testid attributes for all interactive elements
External image URLs used for decorative elements (toran, bells, peacock feathers, temple silhouette)
mix-blend-mode:multiply correctly applied for image blending on pink background
Responsive design uses Tailwind breakpoints (sm:, md:, lg:) appropriately
All links have proper href attributes and accessibility labels
test_credentials: No auth needed - footer is a public component
context_for_next_testing_agent: Janmashtami-themed Footer redesign fully tested and working. All decorative elements (toran garland, bells, peacock feathers, temple silhouette) render correctly. Footer is responsive on mobile (390px). All data-testid attributes present for testing. No console errors.
